description:
Flight planning software for pilots.

SkyDemon Plan provides flight-planning features for pilots on Windows.
- Flight logs can now be automatically backed up to the cloud (iOS, Android)
  If you opt into this feature, your flight logs will be backed up to the cloud automatically. Otherwise, a marker will be shown whenever there are changes that need to be backed up. You can opt out of having the marker displayed.
- Precipitation is now drawn in virtual radar where forecast (iOS, Android, PC)
  To see it, you must have either the rainfall or flyable conditions layers turned on.
- An onscreen keypad can now be used to easily tune a connected radio (iOS, Android)
  The keypad is accessible from inside the Radio tab or by long-pressing it. The keypad is designed to make it much easier to manually enter frequencies than fiddling with your radio.
- You can specify extra time against any leg for aerial work (iOS, Android)
  This is taken account of in the pilot log and in flightplans.
